GrooveMix — install from this zip (Chrome / Chromium-based browsers)
=====================================================================

1. Unzip this file. You'll get a folder named "GrooveMix".
2. Open Chrome and go to: chrome://extensions
3. Turn on "Developer mode" (toggle, top-right corner).
4. Click "Load unpacked".
5. Select the "GrooveMix" folder you unzipped in step 1 (not the zip itself).
6. GrooveMix's icon appears in your toolbar. Click it to open the side panel.

Using it
--------
- Open two YouTube tabs, each playing a track.
- In the GrooveMix side panel, click "Connect" on Deck A and Deck B to link them in.
- Crossfade between decks, adjust EQ/gain, use the keyboard shortcuts shown in the panel legend.
- Click the headphone icon on a deck to preview it on a separate audio output before bringing it into the main mix (pick your cue device once in settings).

Updating
--------
Chrome doesn't auto-update extensions loaded this way. When you get a new zip:
1. Unzip it over (or next to) the old folder.
2. Go to chrome://extensions, find GrooveMix, click the reload icon (⟳).

Feedback
--------
Click the pencil icon (✎) next to "GrooveMix" in the panel to send a quick note — goes straight to us.
Questions: support@groovemix.app
